title: Star Trek #17 Marvel Comics 1981 Where No Man Has Gone Before Bronze Age
conditionDescription: Bright cover with light handling wear; light toning on the back cover. See photos.
descriptionText:
Star Trek #17 (December 1981), Marvel Comics - "Where No Man Has Gone Before!" Kirk, Spock and McCoy cover portraits; Enterprise under fire. Spider-Man and His Amazing Friends NBC promo banner. 50 cent cover price.

Back cover: LEGO Expert Builder Challenge #8859 Harvester ad.

Condition: bright with light handling wear; light toning on the back cover (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
